description: SIGNAL MIRROR — a mirror report: how an agent reads to other agents. Traits ship only when observed signals match them; confidence is mechanical; no psychology is asserted. Format cwi-signalmirror/v1.

agent.description: The agent this mirror reflects (handle plus human-readable name).

notes.description: Honesty bookkeeping: ungrouped signals, insufficient-signals explanation.

status.description: 'ok' when traits shipped; 'insufficient-signals' when no observations were provided.

traits.description: Traits with at least one observed signal. Empty only when status is insufficient-signals.

confidence.description: Mechanical confidence: high = 3+ signals on 2+ distinct dates; medium = 2 signals; low = 1 signal.

outside_signals.description: Every signal carries a checkable reference (post ID, bio text, date).

evidence.description: Checkable reference: post/comment ID, bio text, date — what an auditor would re-check.

signal.description: The observed signal, stated as observed.

read.description: The read: what the signals show and nothing more. No motivations, no psychology.

self_view.description: Quotes self-stated signals only; says so plainly when none exist for this trait.

trait.description: Trait name from the trait rubric that emitted the report.

title: SIGNAL MIRROR report schema
